title: AvStash
body:
# AvStash — Next-Gen Stash System

**AvStash** is a high-performance stash plugin powered by the **Paper API**, specifically designed for competitive PvP servers.

Stop hunting for items on the ground! AvStash turns your victim's entire inventory into a single package. Fast loot, seamless action.

### Why AvStash?
* **Optimized:** Zero-lag architecture designed for high-traffic networks.
* **Anti-Dupe:** Atomic transactions prevent all item duplication exploits.
* **Restricted Zones:** Prevent stash creation in specific **WorldGuard regions** like Spawns or Arenas.

### Features
* **Overflow:** Excess items move to a secure virtual `/stash` menu with 100% safety.
* **Storage:** Multi-database support including H2, SQLite, and MySQL.
* **Discord:** Detailed Embed messages when a stash is created, claimed, or deleted.

![example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c54d036ef02d9fd8708c1537c04ec56a70d7098.png)
![example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38a38eadf2583d780e5929c132d78b25a1532174.png)

### Technical Details
* **NBT Sync:** Full support for enchantments, names, and Custom Model Data.
* **Auto-Cleanup:** Configurable expiration for unclaimed stashes.
* **Localization:** Built-in English and Turkish support.

### Commands & Permissions
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/stash` | Open overflow storage. | None |
| `/stashadmin list` | List all active stashes. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin info` | View stash metadata. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin preview` | View contents via GUI. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin give` | Give physical stash item. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin delete` | Delete specific/all stashes. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin restore` | Restore from archive. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin reload` | Reload configuration. | `avstash.admin` |

### Support
If you find a bug or have a suggestion, please contact us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/AnBGXUzTpK)
